relates to:
- https://github.com/docker/setup-buildx-action/issues/64 encountered Get https://registry-1.docker.io/v2/: net/http: request canceled (Client.Timeout exceeded while awaiting headers) while booting BuildKit.
- https://github.com/docker/setup-buildx-action/issues/445 encountered received unexpected HTTP status: 500 Internal Server Error while pulling moby/buildkit:buildx-stable-1.
- https://github.com/docker/setup-buildx-action/issues/458 encountered download failed after attempts=6: received unexpected HTTP status: 500 Internal Server Error.
- https://github.com/docker/build-push-action/actions/runs/34333465672/job/102407295346?pr=1614#step:5:163: `received unexpected HTTP status: 502 Bad Gateway`

This helps reduce flakes when pulling the BuildKit image through the actions-toolkit simialr to what we do in setup-qemu-action: https://github.com/docker/setup-qemu-action/blob/1f40c72289eff860ee54a304f1438e3cff362e0a/src/main.ts#L23-L25
title: pull BuildKit image before builder creation
